L6·N3701unmasked layer
Fires on the indefinite article "a" (and similar NP-head slots) immediately after a preposition like "with"/"in" — e.g. "consult with a specialist", "speak with a trained advocate", "in a variety of" — i.e. the determiner starting a prepositional object noun phrase; it is suppressed when that slot leads to scheduling nouns ("tight deadline", "schedule", "timetable").

Fires on tokens that complete a repetition — the second occurrence of a word/name/phrase already seen earlier in the passage (induction-like copying), e.g. "this category" after "category", "share in that life" after "life", "blood meal" after "blood meal", "Loyd"/"Nwankwo" repeated surnames.
